description: A grand Parisian-style dining room with elaborate plaster crown molding and ceiling coffers at the cornice line. The walls are painted in a warm off-white with applied panel moulding pilasters flanking an arched doorway at the back right, which opens through to a secondary seating room and beyond to an arched multi-pane window framing green trees. The ceiling height is generous, with smooth white plaster. A large-scale abstract expressionist canvas in mauve, olive, black, and pale pink hangs on the left wall in a thin gilded frame. The dining table is a rectangular slab in dark veined nero marquina marble atop a brass-paneled pedestal base. Around it, six low rounded armchairs in cream bouclé fabric with sculptural thick-legged forms create a casual, organic counterpoint to the formal architecture. A large flat cream wool area rug covers herringbone parquet flooring in warm medium oak beneath the seating group. On the table, two stacked coffee-table books rest as the only styling object. Through the arched passage behind, two grey occasional chairs and a small classical bust sculpture on a column are visible. Bright even natural light enters from the arched window at the back. Camera is at standing eye-level shooting with a normal to slightly wide lens in an off-center composition that shows the full table, all six chairs, and the arched passage into the beyond.
